The function briefs_display_cases takes a list of case IDs. So we can combine.

1. Call court_records_search_cases with location="New York", query="theft", year=2021, limit=5.
2. Call court_records_search_cases with location="San Francisco", query="theft", year=2021, limit=5.
3. Combine case IDs from both responses into a list.
4. Call briefs_display_cases with that list.
